passes.cast: Maren: hair white-silver, skin pale, dark charcoal long coat, steel pauldron, greatsword about her height: matches; braid and red sash not readable at this size. Hilt is over her RIGHT shoulder seen from behind; Cast v1 has it over her LEFT shoulder. Villager: hooded grey, not a Cast member, as the beat's face.
passes.beat: dusk, snow: yes. Maren walks up the road L to R to the palisade gate: yes. Shutters clack shut, a face vanishes: board shows the face at the open shutter, the moment before; only one house roof above the wall, no house shutters visible. Wide, she is small against the wall: wide yes, but she reads about as tall as the palisade behind her (the wall is only about 1.6x a person by the horizon), so not small against it.
passes.cross_view: Gatehouse matches the master (square two-storey tower, hipped snowy roof with posts, one window per face, double gate in arch). Palisade sharpened logs match; road from the SW to the gate matches. House roofs inside above the wall agree with the master.

notes.text: The palisade is only about 1.6x a person against the horizon (left run beside Maren), so she reads about as tall as the wall, not small against it as the beat asks; the plan wants about 3x a person.
notes.fix: Raise the palisade and gatehouse to about 3x a person so she is small beside them.

notes.text: Maren's bare greatsword (left-centre) has its hilt over her right shoulder seen from behind (Cast v1: left shoulder) and lies over her coat with no visible strap holding it.
notes.fix: Mirror the sword to her left shoulder and show the harness strap over it.

notes.text: Only one house roof shows above the wall and no house shutters are visible, so 'shutters on the houses above the wall clack shut' has nothing to act on.
notes.fix: Show a few shuttered upper storeys of the north row above the palisade.

passes.scan: Top-left: night sky, black smoke drifting in from the left, pines. Top-centre/right: long two-storey timber house row with shuttered windows and gabled doorways. Middle-left: palisade run at the back, stone well (cut by the left edge); two village women in headscarves/hats huddled in a lit doorway; small orange flames at the wall base and at the women's boots. Right: Liesl with Tam against the house wall. Bottom: snowy ground. People: Liesl, Tam, two villagers (crowd). No duplicates or ghost faces, no text.
passes.map: Camera in the square beside the east house row, looking north/north-west along it; the row recedes left to meet the palisade at the back; the well stands in front of the palisade at back-left with snowy ground between. Checks: house row inside the palisade, palisade continues behind; no gate in view (fine for this direction). The well sits right in front of the palisade with no north house row behind it, while the plan has the well centre-back with the north row beyond.
passes.support: Tam: holds Liesl's arm/apron, her hand on his shoulder. Liesl's shawl and headscarf worn. Villagers clutch their shawls. Flames sit on the ground at the wall base and at the villagers' feet with no fuel or source shown.
passes.cast: Liesl: brown hair, grey wool headscarf, dark green dress, cream apron, brown fringed shawl: matches the Cast sheet. Tam: black hair, brown fur hat, brown padded coat: matches. Villagers: generic village dress, a crowd, not duplicates of Liesl or Tam.
passes.beat: villagers in the square recoil from her: the two women shrink back into a doorway, yes. Liesl pulls Tam behind her skirt: he clings at her side, partly in front of her apron, not behind her skirt. both look screen-LEFT toward Maren: yes, both faces turned and eyes up-left. Smoke drifts in from the left: yes.
passes.cross_view: Palisade sharpened logs and timber house row match the master. Well position (against the palisade) disagrees with the plan's centre-back.

notes.text: Tam (right) clings at Liesl's side, partly in front of her apron, rather than being pulled behind her skirt.
notes.fix: Put Tam behind her skirt, peeking out, with her arm drawing him back.

notes.text: The well (left) stands right in front of the palisade with no north house row behind it; the plan has it centre-back with the north row beyond.
notes.fix: Set the well further into the square with north-row houses behind it.

notes.text: Small orange flames burn on the snow at the house wall base and at the two villagers' boots (mid-left) with no source, and the women don't react to them.
notes.fix: Remove the flames or tie them to the smoke's source off-screen left.

passes.scan: Top row: snowy pines, roofs of the north-row houses. Middle: houses left, three centre, two right with lit windows; a low palisade line glimpsed between the houses; Maren (left-centre) in profile walking right with a bare greatsword on her back; round stone well behind her. Bottom: snowy square with a dirt track toward the well. People: 1 (Maren). No duplicates, ghosts, or text.
passes.map: Camera at eye height in the square, looking north across the well at the north house row, with house rows turning down the left and right sides; a palisade shows faintly in the gaps between the north houses with forest behind; Maren crosses left to right in front of the well. Matches plate Pc (same houses, well, track), shifted slightly by the camera move. Checks: one well centre, house rows N (and sides), palisade glimpsed behind the row. Scale: the track's edges converge at about y 343 (horizon); Maren's eyes are at about y 230, about 0.3 body heights above it, so with the 1.6 m walk-test camera she stands about 1.5x a normal adult; carried to the house line (base y~390) she would be about 77 px tall against 40 px doors, about 2 door heights.
passes.support: Greatsword: bare blade on her back, crossguard by her left shoulder, hilt above it, blade down past her hip; harness straps across her chest. Feet on the ground. No intersections; the well's left side is hidden behind her coat (occlusion).
passes.cast: Maren: hair white-silver braid down her back, skin pale, dark charcoal long coat with steel pauldron and vambrace, red sash, greatsword on her back with the hilt over her left shoulder (near side, she faces right): matches Cast v1.
passes.beat: walk test, cut c across the square: she walks left to right across the square past the well: yes. No other beat.
passes.cross_view: Against plate Pc: same three north houses with the same window pattern, same side rows, same well and dirt track; nothing added or removed. The faint palisade between the houses agrees with the plate.

notes.text: Maren is too big for the set: her eyes (about y 230) sit about 0.3 body heights above the horizon (about y 343, from the track's converging edges), so against the eye-height walk camera she is about 1.5x an adult; at the north row she would stand about two door heights tall.
notes.fix: Re-make the cut with Maren scaled so her eyes sit on the horizon line.

passes.scan: 4 frames (10.2, 11.2, 12.2, 13.4 s). Each: red paper lantern top-left, navy noren top, slatted wall, counter, steaming stockpot on a burner right, stools foreground. f1/f2: Kuroe seated from behind facing Mio, monocle raised in one hand on its chain, other hand on the bowl; Mio leaning on the counter (f1) / holding the bowl with him (f2); a small white blob in Kuroe's hand at the bowl in f2 only. f3/f4: Kuroe turned on the stool to face camera, monocle worn in his right eye AND a second monocle held up in his left hand with its own chain; Mio holding a ladle over the bowl on the counter. People: Kuroe and Mio in every frame, no pops in/out, no ghosts or text.
passes.map: Night ramen cart: counter runs left-right, Mio behind it with the stockpot on her right, Kuroe on the customer side on a stool, two more stools in the foreground; lantern at the left post. Same layout in all four frames.
passes.support: Kuroe seated on the stool in every frame (seat and legs visible). Monocle(s): f1/f2 one held by its chain in his raised hand; f3/f4 one in the eye socket plus one in his hand, both with chains. Bowl: held by both of them in f1/f2, resting on the counter in f3/f4. Ladle held by Mio in f3/f4. Stockpot on the burner. No intersections.
passes.cast: Kuroe (Cast: hair grey/silver swept back, grey moustache, gold monocle on RIGHT eye with chain to right lapel, black three-piece suit, dark waistcoat, white shirt, burgundy tie, white pocket square): hair grey in f1-f4; suit black in f1-f4 (waistcoat dark grey with a warm lantern tint in f3/f4, a light tint); tie burgundy and pocket square white where visible (f3/f4); moustache grey. Mio: orange-red ponytail, white headband, green apron, black T-shirt: matches in every frame. No colour drift.
passes.beat: Kuroe turns on the stool: from back-to-camera (f1/f2) to facing camera (f3/f4), yes. Holds up the monocle: yes. Mio ladles: ladle in hand over the bowl in f3/f4, yes. 'One more bowl', the monocle now in his hand: in f3/f4 the monocle is in his hand but another is still in his eye, so the monocle is both worn and held.
passes.cross_view: Against the Kuroe Cast front: face, hair, moustache, suit, tie, lapel pin and pocket square match; the Cast has one monocle on the right eye with a chain to the right lapel. In f3/f4 there are two monocles, each with a chain.

notes.text: Duplicate prop in f3 (12.2 s) and f4 (13.4 s): Kuroe wears a gold monocle in his right eye while holding up a second gold monocle on its own chain in his left hand (top-left of each lower frame); the beat says the monocle is now in his hand.
notes.fix: Re-roll C4 so his right eye is bare once the monocle is in his hand.

notes.text: In f2 (11.2 s) a small white blob (cloth or glare) appears in Kuroe's hand at the bowl, not present in f1.
notes.fix: Clean the blob or keep his hand plain on the bowl.
